title: A small shared set of lint and type tools covers every language in the repos
why: Proposed and widened by you, Oct 27 (cmsg_01DoF7thf3iq2Srr1UsfXgh2RAHCgXRgVqY8FQzV1SZAPx, cmsg_01DoF7thf3iq2Srr1UsfXgh2AS65GEmZso8CawVbTFZUGD): no claude-settings step, rule or config covers type checking; c21 covered Ruff and ShellCheck only.
note: Survey and pick: https://claude.ai/artifact/K4ixuAMi4ycpBvgm2x4k3H (checked main d4e1b86). Python: mypy strict one module at a time (banchi, degen, claude-settings), Ruff with bug rules in every Python repo. TS: tsc --noEmit strict everywhere; astro check in joyous; q_max strict over time, its .mjs files get checkJs last. Swift: the compiler, ios-adblock to Swift 6 mode, warnings fail CI; no SwiftLint. ShellCheck spreads to banchi, ios-adblock and home-app. Skip stylelint and sqlfluff. Formatters (ruff format, Prettier, swift-format): adopt after o2, not skip (shiv asked why, Oct 27). Reformat each repo once while no lane is open, list that commit in .git-blame-ignore-revs, then CI checks changed files only; this absorbs c21's planned ruff format; keep zizmor; actionlint only after an incident. Home: one composite action actions/code-check with pinned versions, CI only (c21), a strict list per repo that only grows. Order: claude-settings first, then joyous and ios-adblock, banchi (debt 061 item 8), degen, q_max. The claude-settings part needs no answer. Deferred (shiv, Oct 27): each other repo's roll-out needs your word. Due after: the claude-settings part. Port: yes. Placed after c78 (triage, Oct 27). Consistency (shiv asked, Oct 27): every language gets three layers (type check, bug lint, formatter), or a one-line reason in the standard's table for each layer it skips; the shared action fails on a repo language with no row. Current skips: shell types and format, CSS and SQL types and lint, TS lint outside banchi. Asked: one plan for all child-repo parts, https://claude.ai/artifact/S6Eou4tPnLmypAXzoUdyEA (your pick, Oct 27 11:31 CDT).
